concerns.text: SC-001 requires measuring the Pearson correlation between identified structural features and phase‑change suitability, but no task in tasks.md computes or records this correlation.
SC-002 mandates a paired t‑test comparing interpretable‑model R² to baseline R²; tasks.md contains no task that performs this statistical test.

Constitution principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for raw data files, yet tasks.md lacks any task that generates or records checksums for files such as `data/raw/pcm.parquet` or the CIF directory.
